name: epstein-files-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin (also a standalone MCP server + CLI) for the public DOJ Epstein Files Transparency Act release (~1.4M documents / ~2.8-2.9M pages across 12 DataSets, 20 Datasette databases). Search by full text or sender/recipient/date, resolve any EFTA number to its official DOJ PDF URL, consult a fact-checked known-document registry, and query any of the 20 databases (images, transcripts, OCR, the knowledge graph, and more) including read-only SQL — all via 11 read-only MCP tools.
